sources.articleTitle: Breaking: Trump offers press secretary role to UFC chief Dana White

headline: President-Elect Trump Offers Press Secretary Role To Dana White
seoTitle: Trump Offers Press Secretary Role to Dana White
metaDescription: President-Elect Donald Trump has reportedly offered the role of White House press secretary to UFC chief Dana White following a recent vacancy.
aiSummaryBullets: President-elect Donald Trump has extended an offer for the White House press secretary position to Dana White.
The position has remained vacant since the resignation of former press secretary Katie Zacharia in October.
Katie Zacharia served in the role for less than one week before departing the administration.
aiContextParagraph: The White House press office has experienced instability following the short-lived tenure of Katie Zacharia, who resigned from the post in October after less than a week on the job. Following this vacancy, reports have emerged that President-elect Donald Trump is seeking to fill the position by offering the role to Dana White, the long-time leader of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). This potential appointment marks a departure from traditional political selections for the spokesperson position. The role of White House press secretary involves representing the administration during daily briefings and managing communication between the executive branch and the press corps. The transition team has not yet confirmed whether the UFC chief has accepted the offer, leaving the position officially unfilled as the incoming administration prepares to take office later this year.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained significant attention due to a high public search volume regarding Dana White's potential move into a formal government position.
